top_signals.title: Atlassian warns of critical file-access flaw in Jira, Confluence
top_signals.summary: Atlassian is warning customers of a critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-21589, that can be exploited for arbitrary file-access in multiple self-hosted Data Center products, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Affluent investors seen boosting crypto exposure: Survey
top_signals.summary: Most affluent investors across seven countries own and are increasing their crypto holdings despite financial advisers who remain overly cautious about digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Rep. Don Davis introduces bill to stop federal candidates trading prediction market contracts tied to their own elections
top_signals.summary: Don Davis introduced legislation barring federal candidates and their families from trading prediction contracts tied to their own elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
